title: A Few Words Concerning the Word
theme: The incarnation reveals the eternal Word who was with God and was God, became flesh, dwelt among humanity, and manifested divine grace and truth.

structure.method: Three couplets from John 1:1 and John 1:14

major_sections.title: The First Couplet
major_sections.couplet: In the beginning was the Word — the Word became flesh

major_sections.title: The Second Couplet
major_sections.couplet: The Word was with God — and dwelt among us

major_sections.title: The Third Couplet
major_sections.couplet: The Word was God — full of grace and truth

legacy_source.content_preservation: Original Josh Hetrick legacy sermon preserved unchanged.

brl_import.notes: Assigned as sermon 10 in the BRL-SER-411.xxx Josh Hetrick Legacy Sermon collection.
